FULL TEXT:
Panjab University Constituent College
Vill-Karyal, Dharamkot, Moga
Email:-puccdharmkot@gmail.com
Ref.No 1943/D/PUCCD Date: 02/12/2024.
Advertisement for the post of Guest Faculty of History
Interview for the post of Assistant Professor as Guest Faculty in the subject of
History for Panjab University Constituent College, Vill. Karyal, Dharamkot
(Moga) will be conducted on 16/12/2024 (09:30 AM) at Panjab University
Regional Centre, Ludhiana (Near Fountain Chowk, Opposite Pavilion Mall).
Salary: - As per Panjab University/Punjab Govt.Regulations.
Qualifications: As per Panjab University/UGC norms.
Important Instructions:
1. The applicants are required to fill the application form along with photograph
for the post of Assistant Professors available on the website of the Panjab
University, Chandigarh, available at:
https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/show-forms.php.
2. Application form complete in all respects along with self-attested copies of
all the supporting documents must reach the office of the Principal, Panjab
University Constituent College, Karyal, Dharamkot (Moga) by 13/12/2024 up
to 03:00 pm. The candidates may submit the hard copies of the forms and
documents or soft copies duly self-attested by electronic mode (E-mail) at
puccdharmkot@gmail.com
3. The candidates are required to bring all their original documents on the day
of interview.
4. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the interview.
Principal
